comments.author: @subplotmedia
comments.text: The insurance and maritime risk dynamic is really the unsung linchpin of global chokepoints like Hormuz. It’s fascinating how quickly secondary market mechanics—like P&I clubs withdrawing war-risk cover and the rise of shadow/dark tanker fleets running without Western AIS tracking—reshape supply chains before a single naval shot is even fired. Really sharp analysis of the underlying systemic vulnerabilities.
